mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 5-year average compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 12-month averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above thresholds fails to predict positive returns in > 60% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the regime occurs without positive returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stronger labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and corporate profitability, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below its 5-year average (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects stronger manufacturing output, signaling economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO exceeds 105 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1300 thousand units indicate strong residential construction activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1300 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Joint strength in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month averages signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 and HOUST above thresholds fails to predict positive returns in > 60% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).
